description:

** NO RETURNS ACCEPTED : Forced ebay policy is total B.S.  Know what you are buying!  If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us directly.  Thank you, please drive through.


COMPLETE INSTALLATION SET INCLUDES PNs:  
 
 964 102 239 99 EPW | Engine Flywheel Set - Euro RS Solid Single Mass Lightweight 
  (1) Engine Flywheel - 964 / 993 / 996 GT - Euro RS Solid Single Mass - 60-2 Timing Reference Feature - Precision Balanced - 5.02kg (11.08lb) - SEBRO Germany
  (1) Engine Flywheel Pilot Bearing (964 Euro RS Solid Single Mass Flywheel) - OEM FAG

  (1) Clutch Flywheel Ring Gear - O.E.M. Germany
  (9) Clutch Pressure Plate Bolt - Flywheel Ring Gear to Pressure Plate Cover (8 X 45 mm).  O.E.M. Germany
  (1) Transmission Clutch Release Bearing Guide Tube - O.E.M. Germany
 
 964 116 001 EPW | RS Clubsport Clutch Set For (Euro RS Solid Single Mass Flywheel)
  (1) Clutch Pressure Plate - 964 / 993 3.8L RS Clubsport & 968 - Diameter: 240mm - SACHS
  (1) Clutch Friction Disc - Diameter: 240mm - 4x Torsion Spring Hub Center - SACHS
  (1) Manual Transmission Clutch Releaser Bearing - SACHS
  

Applications:  This set is specifically engineered for use in place of the original type double-mass flywheel.
+ (1989-1998) 964, 993 Carrera 2 / 4 / 3.6L-3.8L RS / RS Amerika / RS Clubsport / Speedster - All Models: Engine Codes (M64.01/02/03/05/06/07/08/20/21/22/23/24/60)
- (NOT RECOMMENDED FOR TURBO, GT2 OR GT3 MODELS*) *Please contact us for proper supporting parts for these applications.


Replaces PNs: 
964 102 239 31 | Double-Mass Engine Flywheel - 964 / 993 | 14.36kg (31.65lb)
964 114 012 52 | Double-Mass Engine Flywheel - 993 Turbo | 14.36kg (31.65lb) (Supersedes to PN: 996 114 012 50)
996 114 012 50 | Double-Mass Engine Flywheel - 933 Turbo / 996 / 997 / Turbo / GT Models | 14.83kg (32.70lb)


Installation Notes: 
+ The solid flywheel has a pocketed feature in the center allowing room for the torsion spring centered clutch discs.  Despite what the spring center indicates, the raised hub inserts into the pocket on the flywheel side. 
+ The starter ring gear has a stepped feature which fits between the flywheel and clutch pressure plate.  The flat side face mounts to the flywheel and the stepped register serves to hold the clutch pressure plate cover concentric.


Features & Expectations:
+ The intentions of the double mass flywheel serve to reduce harmonics, sound and judder.
+ The use of this flywheel set significantly reduces the weight (~8.62kg /19lbs) and rotational mass on the drivetrain.  This significantly affects the performance and handling.
+ The engine will rev quicker and build RPM faster for better response and acceleration.  An adjustment to your driving style is needed when taking off from a standing start.  With most clubsport style clutches featuring organic facings and spring torsion hub centers, it is possible to start off in second gear slowly feathering the clutch.  
+ Increased sound and rattling will be evident at low speeds and while at rest idling.  This rattling is not damaging or unbearable but definitely evident.  Slight pressure on the gear shift lever or clutch pedal will suppress the noise.  
+ (1990-1995) 964 & 993 Models originally equipped with the double mass flywheel typically require electronic or idle adjustment to compensate for the quicker decel of the engine.  Such models with higher miles may also have increased idle stabilization problems which can also be complicated with vacuum system leaks.  The Digital Motor Electronics (Bosch Motronic) as found in (1984-1995 OBD I) feature an EPROM chip that can be retrofitted with a tuned version adjusting for the lightened flywheel (map decel values) and other engine updates.*  (1996- OBD II) Models are self correcting and updates are not required.  
* Please contact us with your cars configuration if you would like us to also provide a performance EPROM chip.  (From $475.00)

Clutch Type Features:
+ Road Sport type clutch pressure plate for minimal stiffness for standard pedal effort and travel. 
+ Torsion spring hub center disc and organic facings for smooth engagement.  Ideal for lightweight, solid single mass flywheel applications.  
+ Expect smooth engagement and easy operation in traffic while offering higher durability and performance with clubsport and autocross use.

Supporting Parts:
+ Additional flywheel options are available.  If you should require a flywheel lighter or heavier weight please contact us.
+ For road going models, it is highly recommended using an organic facings, torsion spring centered disc for smoother clutch engagement.
+ Proper clutch system application is important to installation success.  Please review our clutch sets or contact us for the latest clutch matching options.

+ Expect smooth engagement and easy operation in traffic while offering higher durability and performance with clubsport and autocross use.

(1) Clutch Pressure Plate - 964 / 993 3.8L RS Clubsport & 968 - Diameter: 240mm - SACHS
(1) Clutch Friction Disc - Diameter: 240mm - 4x Torsion Spring Hub Center - SACHS
(1) Manual Transmission Clutch Releaser Bearing - OEM SACHS


Applications:  This set is specifically engineered for use in place of the original type double-mass flywheel.
+ (1989-1998) 964, 993 Carrera 2 / 4 / 3.6L-3.8L RS / RS Amerika / RS Clubsport / Speedster - All Models: Engine Codes (M64.01/02/03/05/06/07/08/20/21/22/23/24/60)
- (NOT RECOMMENDED FOR TURBO, GT2 OR GT3 MODELS*) *Please contact us for proper supporting parts for these applications. GT or Turbo applications we suggest alternate clutch sets.


Replaces PNs: (~40% Mass Reduction)
964 102 239 31 | Double-Mass Engine Flywheel - 964 / 993 | 14.36kg (31.65lb)
964 114 012 52 | Double-Mass Engine Flywheel - 993 Turbo | 14.36kg (31.65lb) (Supersedes to PN: 996 114 012 50)
996 114 012 50 | Double-Mass Engine Flywheel - 933 Turbo / 996 / 997 / Turbo / GT Models | 14.83kg (32.70lb)


Installation Notes: 
+ The solid flywheel has a pocketed feature in the center allowing room for the torsion spring centered clutch discs.  Despite what the spring center indicates, the raised hub inserts into the pocket on the flywheel side. 
+ The starter ring gear has a stepped feature which fits between the flywheel and clutch pressure plate.  The flat side face mounts to the flywheel and the stepped register serves to hold the clutch pressure plate cover concentric.


Features & Expectations:
+ The intentions of the double mass flywheel serve to reduce harmonics, sound and judder.
+ The use of this flywheel set significantly reduces the weight (~8.62kg /19lbs) and rotational mass on the drivetrain.  This significantly affects the performance and handling.
+ The engine will rev quicker and build RPM faster for better response and acceleration.  An adjustment to your driving style is needed when taking off from a standing start.  With most clubsport style clutches featuring organic facings and spring torsion hub centers, it is possible to start off in second gear slowly feathering the clutch.  
+ Increased sound and rattling will be evident at low speeds and while at rest idling.  This rattling is not damaging or unbearable but definitely evident.  Slight pressure on the gear shift lever or clutch pedal will suppress the noise.  
+ Specially suited for (1990-1995) 964 & 993 Models originally equipped with the double mass flywheel typically require electronic or idle adjustment to compensate for the quicker decel of the engine.  Such models with higher miles may also have increased idle stabilization problems which can also be complicated with vacuum system leaks.  The Digital Motor Electronics (Bosch Motronic) as found in (1984-1995 OBD I) feature an EPROM chip that can be retrofitted with a tuned version adjusting for the lightened flywheel (map decel values) and other engine updates.*  (1996- OBD II) Models are self correcting and updates are not required.  This set is specially designed with increased mass to smooth and prevent idle and stalling issues.
* Please contact us with your cars configuration if you would like us to also provide a performance EPROM chip.  (From $475.00)

Clutch Type Features:
+ Road Sport type clutch pressure plate for minimal stiffness for standard pedal effort and travel. 
+ Torsion spring hub center disc and organic facings for smooth engagement.  Ideal for lightweight, solid single mass flywheel applications.  
+ Expect smooth engagement and easy operation in traffic while offering higher durability and performance with clubsport and autocross use.

Supporting Parts:
+ Additional flywheel options are available.  If you should require a flywheel lighter or heavier weight please contact us.
+ For road going models, it is highly recommended using an organic facings, torsion spring centered disc for smoother clutch engagement.
+ Proper clutch system application is important to installation success.  Please review our clutch sets or contact us for the latest clutch matching options.

Application Requirements: 
+ This set is specifically designed to replace the flywheel and clutch system found on models equipped with double-mass flywheels as found on all Porsche models from 1990-.  
+ This set to be combined with a match clutch system.
+ Models converting from dual mass flywheels require clutch release bearing PN: 944 116 080 01 / SACHS 3151 227 001 (Features Extended Fork Ears)

PORSCHE 964 993 RS Clutch Set Clubsport Endurance SACHS Performance

PORSCHE 911 964 965 Turbo Clutch Conversion Set SACHS Pressure Plate, Disc MP43


Installation Notes: 
+ The solid flywheel has a pocketed feature in the center allowing room for the torsion spring centered clutch discs.  Despite what the spring center indicates, the raised hub inserts into the pocket on the flywheel side. 
+ The starter ring gear has a stepped feature which fits between the flywheel and clutch pressure plate.  The flat side face mounts to the flywheel and the stepped register serves to hold the clutch pressure plate cover concentric.


Features & Expectations:
+ The intentions of the double mass flywheel serve to reduce harmonics, sound and judder.
+ The use of this flywheel set significantly reduces the weight (~8.62kg /19lbs) and rotational mass on the drivetrain.  This significantly affects the performance and handling.
+ The engine will rev quicker and build RPM faster for better response and acceleration.  An adjustment to your driving style is needed when taking off from a standing start.  With most clubsport style clutches featuring organic facings and spring torsion hub centers, it is possible to start off in second gear slowly feathering the clutch.  
+ Increased sound and rattling will be evident at low speeds and while at rest idling.  This rattling is not damaging or unbearable but definitely evident.  Slight pressure on the gear shift lever or clutch pedal will suppress the noise.  
+ (1990-1995) 964 & 993 Models originally equipped with the double mass flywheel typically require electronic or idle adjustment to compensate for the quicker decel of the engine.  Such models with higher miles may also have increased idle stabilization problems which can also be complicated with vacuum system leaks.  The Digital Motor Electronics (Bosch Motronic) as found in (1984-1995 OBD I) feature an EPROM chip that can be retrofitted with a tuned version adjusting for the lightened flywheel (map decel values) and other engine updates.  (1996- OBD II) Models are self correcting and updates are not required.  

Supporting Parts:
+ Additional flywheel options are available.  If you should require a flywheel lighter or heavier weight please contact us.
+ For road going models, it is highly recommended using an organic facings, torsion spring centered disc for smoother clutch engagement.
+ Proper clutch system application is important to installation success.  Please review our clutch sets or contact us for the latest clutch matching options.

Application Requirements: 
+ This set is specifically designed to replace the flywheel and clutch system found on models equipped with double-mass flywheels as found on all Porsche models from 1990-1994.  Note: This set is not compatible with 1989 930 Turbo Models.  Please contact us for other parts options.  
+ This set to be combined with a match clutch system.
+ Models converting from dual mass flywheels require clutch release bearing PN: 944 116 080 01 / SACHS 3151 227 001 (Features Extended Fork Ears)


Installation Notes: 
+ The solid flywheel has a pocketed feature in the center allowing room for the torsion spring centered clutch discs.  Despite what the spring center indicates, the raised hub inserts into the pocket on the flywheel side. 
+ The starter ring gear has a stepped feature which fits between the flywheel and clutch pressure plate.  The flat side face mounts to the flywheel and the stepped register serves to hold the clutch pressure plate cover concentric.


Features & Expectations:
+ The intentions of the double mass flywheel serve to reduce harmonics, sound and judder.
+ The use of this set significantly reduces the weight (~8.62kg /19lbs) and rotational mass on the drivetrain.  This reduction in the moment of inertia significantly affects the performance and handling.
+ The engine will rev quicker and build RPM faster for better response and acceleration.  An adjustment to your driving style is needed when taking off from a standing start.  With most clubsport style clutches featuring organic facings and spring torsion hub centers, it is possible to start off in second gear slowly feathering the clutch.  
+ Increased sound and rattling will be evident at low speeds and while at rest idling.  This rattling is not damaging or unbearable but definitely evident.  Slight pressure on the gear shift lever or clutch pedal will suppress the noise.  


Supporting Parts:
+ Additional flywheel options are available.  If you should require a flywheel lighter or heavier weight please contact us.
+ For road going models, it is highly recommended using an organic facings, torsion spring centered disc for smoother clutch engagement.
+ Proper clutch system application is important to installation success.  Please review our clutch sets or contact us for the latest clutch matching options.

Application Notes: 
+ This set is specifically designed to replace the flywheel and clutch system found on models equipped with double-mass flywheels as found on all Porsche models from 1990-.  
+ This set to be combined with a match clutch system.
+ Models converting from dual mass flywheels require clutch release bearing PN: 944 116 080 01 / SACHS 3151 227 001 (Features Extended Fork Ears)

Check it out

PORSCHE 964 993 RS Clutch Set Clubsport Pressure Plate Disc Release Bearing SACH(Item ID: 222099370086)





PORSCHE 964 993 Flywheel & Clutch Set Euro RS Clubsport Single Mass Mid-weight

PORSCHE 964 993 Flywheel & Clutch Set Euro RS Clubsport Single Mass Lightweight

PORSCHE 964 993 RS Clutch Set Clubsport Endurance SACHS Performance

PORSCHE 911 964 965 Turbo Clutch Conversion Set SACHS Pressure Plate, Disc MP43


Installation Notes: 
+ The solid flywheel has a pocketed feature in the center allowing room for the torsion spring centered clutch discs.  Despite what the spring center indicates, the raised hub inserts into the pocket on the flywheel side. 
+ The starter ring gear has a stepped feature which fits between the flywheel and clutch pressure plate.  The flat side face mounts to the flywheel and the stepped register serves to hold the clutch pressure plate cover concentric.


Features & Expectations:
+ The intentions of the double mass flywheel serve to reduce harmonics, sound and judder.
+ The use of this flywheel set significantly reduces the weight (~8.62kg /19lbs) and rotational mass on the drivetrain.  This significantly affects the performance and handling.
+ The engine will rev quicker and build RPM faster for better response and acceleration.  An adjustment to your driving style is needed when taking off from a standing start.  With most clubsport style clutches featuring organic facings and spring torsion hub centers, it is possible to start off in second gear slowly feathering the clutch.  
+ Increased sound and rattling will be evident at low speeds and while at rest idling.  This rattling is not damaging or unbearable but definitely evident.  Slight pressure on the gear shift lever or clutch pedal will suppress the noise.  
+ (1990-1995) 964 & 993 Models originally equipped with the double mass flywheel typically require electronic or idle adjustment to compensate for the quicker decel of the engine.  Such models with higher miles may also have increased idle stabilization problems which can also be complicated with vacuum system leaks.  The Digital Motor Electronics (Bosch Motronic) as found in (1984-1995 OBD I) feature an EPROM chip that can be retrofitted with a tuned version adjusting for the lightened flywheel (map decel values) and other engine updates.  (1996- OBD II) Models are self correcting and updates are not required.  

Supporting Parts:
+ Additional flywheel options are available.  If you should require a flywheel lighter or heavier weight please contact us.
+ For road going models, it is highly recommended using an organic facings, torsion spring centered disc for smoother clutch engagement.
+ Proper clutch system application is important to installation success.  Please review our clutch sets or contact us for the latest clutch matching options.

MoTeC's mini colour display, the D153, features an anti-reflective, TFT LCD screen with exceptional brightness and clarity for easy viewing in strong sunlight.


Like the MDD it replaced, the D153 is an ideal size for steering wheel mounting and is designed to be controlled and configured by a MoTeC data logger. Numerous inputs are provided for buttons and dials, enabling the unit to activate functions in other CAN-based devices, such as traction control and pitlane speed limiting, with minimal wiring.


MoTeC's initial release provides fixed layouts and selectable channels, allowing users to choose the parameters they wish to monitor in various modes. Full screen configurability will be offered in future and most customers will be able to upgrade their existing unit via a software update.


Display Creator


Designed for use with MoTeC’s Colour Displays and Display Loggers, this intuitive and powerful software allows you to fully customise your onscreen graphics.


With Display Creator you can maximise the potential of your high resolution display by generating layouts specifically for your application. Add sponsor logos, design your own gauges, create unique warning screens, use non-English labels and define parameters to suit your individual needs.


Display Creator is free to download and comes with samples to get you started. D1 Series Displays do not require any enable to accept Display Creator files.


Learn more about Display Creator


Other models


The D175, a larger display with built in shift lights is also available and is ideal for dash mounting.

  • Compact case for mounting to steering wheels

  • Receives display messages from MoTeC data loggers

Product Description

Bilstein B16 (PSS10) suspension kits feature ride height adjustability with 10-stage manually adjustable dampers in an OE quality, direct fit package. The 10-stage damping system adjusts both rebound and compression with each click to provide the best handling performance in any condition. These kits offer monotube performance dampers with matched springs that are tuned for each specific application. The zinc coated and threaded body design will give you the flexibility to find the perfect ride height setting for your intended use while providing unsurpassed protection against the harshest road elements. B16 (PSS10) suspension kits are made in Germany and feature technology tested on the famed Nürburgring.
